memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, the enforced C26 lint rejects snake_case names on def/abbrev (theorems may use _of_ suffixes; defs must be lowerCamelCase), and the pre-commit typst-sync gate refuses a .lean commit until typst/generated/status.typ and the generated README inventory blocks reflect every live .lean file, including untracked new modules -- so a phase adding a module needs one commit carrying status.typ and the three READMEs.
Mathlib's linter.style.show flags the `show` tactic (counted by C28 warning budget in BimodalLogic); use `change` instead.
